title: gf2-core PPC-spiral performance sweep
description:
Comprehensive sweep through every scalar gap in `gf2-core` using the Aalto PPC optimization spiral (V0 measure → V1 linearise → V2 ILP → V3 SIMD → V4 register tile → V4cache cache block → V5 reuse → V6 prefetch → V7 layout → V10 multithread). New SIMD kernels live in `gf2-kernels-simd` behind the `OnceLock` dispatch boundary; high-level code stays `#![deny(unsafe_code)]`.

## Plan / spec doc

`/home/vkaskivuo/.claude/plans/analyze-the-core-library-sprightly-sprout.md` — attached as the epic's design doc.

## Stories (one per tier)

- **S0** chore: PPC-spiral measurement infrastructure (I1–I4)
- **SA** perf: route scalar callers through existing SIMD dispatch (A1–A3)
- **SB** perf: dense bit-matrix SIMD kernels (B1–B3)
- **SC** perf: field-arithmetic batch kernels (C1–C5)
- **SD** perf: sparse matvec layout + prefetch (D1–D2)
- **SE** perf: multithread scaled kernels (E1–E2)

## Epic-level success criteria

- [hard] Every Tier A–D kernel ships with: criterion bench, sibling `.asm.txt` artefact, scalar-vs-SIMD proptest equivalence, and ≥1.5× geomean over the pinned baseline at the kernel's design size class.
- [hard] `cargo nextest run --workspace --all-features --release --profile ci` passes at fast tier (5 s/test cap).
- [hard] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` clean.
- [hard] No `unsafe` leaked outside `gf2-kernels-simd` (`#![deny(unsafe_code)]` preserved everywhere else).
- [hard] MSRV stays at 1.80 unless explicitly user-approved per `escalation-policy.md` (only Tier-C C3 IFMA52 sub-task may need this, and only if AVX2 path is below the 1.5× bar).
- [aspirational] Geomean speedup across all Tier A–D kernels ≥ 2× over the baseline (some kernels are cache-bound and will fall short of this on their own).

## Execution

Phase 2 of the plan is autonomous: invoke `/project-lead <this-epic-short-id>` once Phase 1 (issue scaffolding) completes. Project-lead breaks down stories further as needed via `jit-breakdown`, dispatches workers in worktrees for parallel-safe tasks, and runs holistic coherence review. Per memory `feedback_agents_no_gate_runs.md`, only the lead transitions JIT gate state.

## Context

- Plan-mode exploration confirmed 22 scalar kernels with obvious SIMD shape across `matrix.rs`, `sparse.rs`, `gf2m/`, `gfp/`, `gfpn/`, `alg/m4rm.rs`.
- Existing dispatch pattern: `gf2_core::simd::maybe_simd()`, `maybe_gf2m()`, `maybe_mersenne()`, `maybe_fp65537()`, `maybe_gf2m_wide256()` all return `Option<&'static FnsStruct>` via `OnceLock`.
- Existing batch-field SIMD: `Fp<65537>` and `Fp<2^31-1>` only; this epic generalises to other primes.
- Existing rayon-parallel layer: `crates/gf2-core/src/compute/cpu.rs`.
- Recent baseline data lives under `target/criterion/` (Apr 18–25, 2026); I1 pins it.
